title: SCN–IgG functionalized NaYF4:Yb3+/(Er3+,Tm3+) upconversion nanoparticles for targeted fluorescence imaging of liver cancer cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22682-22689
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03912F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ha Thi Phuong, Tran Thu Huong, Le Thi Vinh, Do Thi Thao, Le Anh Tu, Tong Quang Cong, Nguyen Duc Van, Tran Quoc Tien
NaYF4:Yb3+/(Er3+,Tm3+) UCNPs were synthesized via a hydrothermal method and sequentially functionalized with silica shell, amine groups, thiocyanate (SCN), and immunoglobulin G (IgG) to enhance their biocompatibility and targeting capabilities.
